project_info.description: Validation test for Systems A-F generalizability using 8-ID ISS beamline XAS operando measurements
project_info.validation_purpose: Verify Systems A-F architecture works for time-resolved operando measurements with System F (async DAQ)

knowledge_gaps: System D - Ru6IrOx catalyst oxidation state evolution and degradation mechanism

scientific_goal.primary_goal: Infer catalyst degradation mechanism from operando XAS measurements
scientific_goal.target_discovery: Ru oxidation state evolution, Ir stabilization mechanism, degradation pathway

published_results.degradation: Ru dissolution to Ru^6+, Ir subsurface stabilization

scientific_goal.success_criteria: Gap closure qualitatively identifies Ru oxidation and degradation pathway

notes: Pre-built validation case with Systems A-F. System F (async DAQ) is REQUIRED for operando measurements.
